what: a tall narrow glass bottle with four flat sides and square shoulders, closed with a thick stopper of bright silver shaped like a plain knob. The bottle is three quarters full of one slow curling wisp of silvery-white vapour, like a ribbon of smoke turning inside the glass.
colours: Clear pale grey glass with white glints, silvery-white vapour inside with pale lilac-grey shadows, a bright silver stopper.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: a curl of fine hair: one soft thick lock of long silky hair, pale ash-blond, lying in a loose curve like the letter S, tied near its upper end with a few turns of thin dark thread, above which a short tuft sticks out; below the tie the lock hangs long and wavy and thins to a curling wispy tip. Every strand is fine as silk and the lock is soft and smooth, never stiff.
colours: Pale ash-blond hair, nearly cream, with soft grey-brown shadows between the strands, one thin band of dark brown thread.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the tied end at the top right, the long wavy lock curving down to its wispy tip at the bottom left.
must_show: one soft wavy lock of pale hair
tied near one end with dark thread

what: a root made of stone: one thick, gnarled, twisting root of solid grey rock, as thick as a wrist at its upper end, bending twice like a tree root and forking at its lower end into three short blunt stone rootlets. Its surface is rough cracked granite with sharp chipped edges, plainly stone and not wood.
colours: Cold mid-grey granite with charcoal cracks and pale grey lit ridges; nothing else.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the thick broken end at the top right, the three rootlets spreading at the bottom left.

what: a coil of sinew cord: one thick pale cord, as thick as a little finger, wound round and round into a flat neat coil of five turns like a coiled bowstring, with one loose end of the cord sticking out from the coil at the upper right. The cord is smooth, waxy and a little glistening.
colours: Pale cream-white cord with warm tan shadows between the turns and a faint flesh-pink tint; nothing else.
pose: Seen from above and a little to one side, the coil a flat ring with a dark gap in its middle.
must_show: one flat coil of thick pale cord

what: a sealed glass bubble: one perfectly round ball of thin clear glass, with no neck and no stopper, closed at the very top by one small flat cap of dark grey lead. Inside the ball hangs a soft cloud of pale mist with three big round air bubbles in it, each a quarter as wide as the ball.
colours: Clear glass with white glints, pale sea-blue mist inside, the blue of a winter sky, three white-rimmed bubbles, a dark grey lead cap.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: pale blue mist and big bubbles inside

what: a tiny vial: one very small bottle of thick clear crystal shaped like a falling teardrop, round and fat at the bottom and narrowing to a point at the top, where it is sealed by a small cap of yellow gold with a ring on it. Hanging in the middle of the crystal is one single large round drop of bright liquid light, as wide as half the vial.
colours: Clear colourless crystal with white glints, one drop of bright pale yellow-white light, a yellow gold cap.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: a length of silk ribbon: one long, broad, perfectly flat band as wide as three fingers, laid back and forth upon itself in four big soft flat folds, one above the other, like a ribbon snaking down a page in the shape of a wide letter S twice over, with its upper cut end at the top left and its lower cut end trailing away to the bottom right. It is not tied, not knotted and not looped. The ribbon is perfectly smooth and shines like polished metal, bright along every bend.
colours: Bright silver-white silk with pale sky-blue shadows in the folds and pure white shine on the ridges; nothing else.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, a wide zigzag of flat ribbon, wider than it is tall.
must_show: folded back and forth in wide flat bends

what: one ancient shoe of the Viking age: a single soft slipper-like shoe with no heel at all, a flat sole as thick as two fingers built of many stacked layers, a blunt round toe, and a low soft upper that rises only to the ankle bone, with no laces, no strap and no fastening of any kind. The whole upper is a crude patchwork: about a dozen large odd-shaped scraps of leather, each a different dark brown, sewn edge to edge with big thick pale stitches like the stitches on a rag doll. The shoe is empty, with a dark hollow opening at the ankle.
colours: Scraps of very dark walnut brown, dull grey-brown and dark chestnut leather, never bright, pale bone-coloured stitching, a nearly black sole.
pose: Seen from the side and a little from the front, upright as if resting, toe pointing to the left, the dark empty ankle opening at the top right.
must_show: patchwork of many leather scraps with visible stitches

what: a scrap of leather: one small stiff flat offcut of thick shoe leather, shaped like a rough triangle with one curved side, as if trimmed from round the toe of a shoe. Its top is smooth dark hide; its cut edges are thick, pale and fuzzy, and a row of four empty stitch holes runs along the curved side.
colours: Dark chestnut-brown leather on top, pale tan raw cut edges, black stitch holes.
pose: Lying flat, seen from above and a little to one side, so its thick cut edge shows.
must_show: one small flat piece of leather
rough triangle with a curved side

what: a single great thorn: one fat, hard, curved thorn shaped like the claw of a big cat, a third as wide at its base as it is long, bending in one smooth curve and tapering to one sharp point. Its wide base is a pale ragged oval where it was snapped off. It is perfectly smooth all over, with nothing growing from its sides, and glossy as polished horn.
colours: Glossy black with dark brown-black shadows, one long bright pale tan glint running down its lit upper side, and a pale tan broken base.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the thick broken base at the bottom left corner, the sharp point at the top right corner.

what: a single loose eyeball like a big glass marble: one perfectly round ball of milky, cloudy white, cold and hard as a sea-worn stone, with one large round iris of pale grey on its front, turned a little to the viewer's left, and a small soft dark pupil in the middle of the iris. A faint web of pale grey veins clouds the white.
colours: Milky bone-white ball with pale grey shading, a pale grey iris with a darker grey ring, a dark grey pupil.
pose: Seen from the front, a round ball, the iris facing the viewer and a little to the left.

what: an old oil lamp of the Arabian Nights kind: one low, boat-shaped brass lamp with a long curving spout reaching out to the right, a looped handle at the left, a small domed lid with a knob on top, and a round flared foot beneath. It is dented, dull and tarnished, with dark stains in every hollow, and gives no light.
colours: Dull tarnished yellow-brown brass, dark brown in the dents and hollows, with a few worn bright yellow edges.
pose: Standing upright on its foot, seen from the side and a little from above, spout pointing right, handle at the left.

what: a small solid bronze figurine of a bull, a votive statuette of ancient Crete: a heavy-shouldered bull standing foursquare on four short thick legs with its head lowered, two long horns sweeping forward and up, a thick neck and a short tail lying against its flank. The metal is worn smooth and rounded by handling, with no fine detail left, plainly a cast metal statuette and not a living animal.
colours: Bright warm yellow-brown bronze like a polished brass door-knob, dark brown in the hollows, pale yellow shine on the back and horns.
pose: Seen from the side, standing level, head to the left.
must_show: one small metal statuette of a bull

what: an ancient wooden idol: one small, stiff, primitive statuette carved from a single block of very dark, age-blackened wood, a rigid upright column of a figure in a long straight gown with its feet together on a small square block that is part of it. It is the armed goddess Athena in the oldest style: on its head a tall crested helmet, in its raised right fist a short thick upright spear, on its left arm a big round shield held in front of its body. The carving is simple and blocky, cracked along the grain, plainly a wooden statue.
colours: Very dark walnut-brown wood, nearly black in the cracks, with worn paler brown edges on the helmet crest, the shield rim and the spear.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front.

what: a sealed ancient Greek storage jar, a pithos: one stout egg-shaped jar of fired clay, widest at the shoulder and narrowing to a small flat foot, with two small loop handles on its shoulders and a flat round clay lid. The lid is tied down with thick dark cord wound crosswise over it and round the neck, and a big blob of dark wax seals the knot at the front. Round the belly of the jar runs one broad band painted with small black running figures, in the manner of a Greek black-figure vase.
colours: Warm brown fired clay, the colour of a clay flowerpot left to weather, with matt black painted figures and bands, dark brown cord, a blob of dark brown wax.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: lid tied down with cord and sealed with wax

what: an ancient Sumerian tablet: one thick slab of black obsidian, taller than it is wide, shaped like a pillow, with rounded corners and slightly bulging faces, as thick as a thumb. Its whole front is covered by six level rows of large wedge-shaped cuneiform marks, each mark a bold short stroke filled with pale gold. One jagged crack runs down from the top right corner to the middle.
colours: Glossy black stone with one long cold white glint down its left edge and a charcoal-grey sheen on its face, pale gold wedge marks, a thin pale grey crack.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, tilted a little so that its thick left edge shows.
must_show: one thick black tablet with rounded corners

what: a pair of golden balance scales: one thick upright gold post rising from a round stepped gold foot, with a small pair of spread wings in gold at its top; across the top lies one thick straight level beam, and from each end of the beam hangs one broad shallow round pan on three short thick gold chains. The two pans hang level with each other and both are empty. Everything is heavy and boldly made, the chains as thick as a finger.
colours: Rich yellow gold all over, deep brown-gold in the shadows, bright pale gold highlights.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front, perfectly balanced, one pan at the left and one at the right.
must_show: upright post on a round foot

what: a very small old book: one little thick pocket-sized book, closed, bound in dark red leather. Its front cover carries one bold raised design pressed into the leather: a single upright stem rising from a small cup and branching into four big curling leaves, inside a plain raised rectangular border. The leather is rubbed and darkened at the corners, and the thick block of pages shows cream at the edges.
colours: Deep dark red leather, almost brown in the hollows, the raised vine the same red a shade lighter, cream page edges.
pose: Closed, the front cover to the viewer, tilted a little so that the spine at the left and the page edges at the bottom show.
must_show: raised vine design on the cover

what: the philosopher's stone: one smooth, heavy, egg-shaped stone, a little longer than it is wide, polished like a river pebble, with no facets and no setting. It is a deep glowing red all the way through, as if lit from within, brightest at its heart, and a few small flecks of gold float inside it near the middle.
colours: Deep ruby red, brighter warm scarlet at the heart, dark wine-red at the rim, one white glint at the upper left, small yellow-gold flecks.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from the front, tilted a little, the long way from lower left to upper right.

what: a lodestone: one heavy rough lump of black magnetic rock, wider than it is tall, a plain boulder with blunt broken faces and no shape to it. One big iron horseshoe clings flat against the middle of its front, and three very large iron nails, each as long as the stone is tall and as thick as a finger, with big square heads, stick straight out from its top like the spines of a hedgehog.
colours: Dull matt black stone with dark slate-grey facets and one thin pale steel-grey lit edge along its top, dark grey iron nails and horseshoe with pale worn tips.
pose: Lying by itself, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: one rough black lump of rock
three big iron nails sticking out of the top

what: a courier's scroll case: one stout tube of dark hard leather, as long as a forearm and as thick as a wrist, the same width all along, bound by three broad dark iron bands, one at each end and one in the middle, and closed at each end by a flat iron cap. Over the join of the cap at the upper end sits one large round blob of dark red sealing wax, as wide as the tube, stamped with a plain shield shape, and a short loop of leather strap hangs from the middle band.
colours: Very dark chestnut-brown leather, dark grey iron bands with pale worn edges, one dark red wax seal.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the plain capped end at the bottom left corner, the end with the red wax seal at the top right corner.
must_show: one leather tube with iron bands
big red wax seal at one end

what: a soul sphere, an ancient vessel for holding a spirit: one round globe of thick dark smoky glass as big as two fists, the same dark glass all over, held in a cage of two thick hoops of dark iron. Both hoops run from the top of the globe to the bottom, like the lines of longitude on a map globe: they cross each other at the very top and at the very bottom and nowhere else, so that the glass shows between them in four tall curved panes. At the top where the hoops cross is a small iron cap with one small iron ring standing on it; at the bottom where they cross is a small iron knob. Inside the glass, in its middle, swirls one pale wisp of soul-light, coiled like a twist of smoke, bright white at its heart and pale icy blue at its edges, the brightest thing in the picture. The glass is thick; the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Dark smoky blue-black glass with a white glint; dark charcoal iron hoops with pale grey riveted edges; a coiled wisp of white and pale icy blue light inside.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, upright, the small ring at the top.
must_show: two iron hoops running top to bottom, crossing at the top and bottom
pale swirling wisp of light inside
must_not_show: upper half one colour and lower half another

what: an unusual soul sphere, an ancient vessel for holding a spirit: one round globe of thick black glass as big as two fists, the same black glass all over, held in a cage of two thick hoops of bright gold. Both hoops run from the top of the globe to the bottom, like the lines of longitude on a map globe: they cross each other at the very top and at the very bottom and nowhere else, so that the glass shows between them in four tall curved panes. At the top where the hoops cross is a small gold cap with one small gold ring standing on it; at the bottom where they cross is a small gold knob. Inside the glass, in its middle, swirls one pale wisp of soul-light, coiled like a twist of smoke, bright white at its heart and pale silver at its edges, the brightest thing in the picture. The glass is thick; the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Glossy black glass with a white glint; bright yellow gold hoops with brown-gold shadows; a coiled wisp of white and pale silver light inside.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, upright, the small ring at the top.
must_show: two gold hoops running top to bottom, crossing at the top and bottom
pale swirling wisp of light inside
must_not_show: upper half one colour and lower half another

what: a seal of the Abyss: one thick round disc of dark iron, glowing hot, a seal as wide as a man's palm and as thick as a finger, like a huge heavy coin, with a broad raised rim all the way round. Filling its face, raised in the metal, is one single large flame with three tongues, and the whole face of the disc glows like metal just drawn from the fire, brightest in the middle. It has no chain, no loop and no handle.
colours: Glowing blood-red face, bright scarlet and yellow-white at the heart of the flame mark, a nearly black iron rim.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, a round disc tilted a very little so that its thick edge shows at the lower right.
must_show: one thick round disc with a raised rim

what: a seal of the Abyss: one thick round disc of rusted iron, a seal as wide as a man's palm and as thick as a finger, like a huge heavy coin, with a broad raised rim all the way round. Filling its face, raised in the metal, are two short broad swords crossed in an X, points upward. The whole disc is pitted and eaten with rust. It has no chain, no loop and no handle.
colours: Dark rust red-brown, the colour of an old iron nail, with brighter rust-red patches and two pale steel-grey crossed swords.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, a round disc tilted a very little so that its thick edge shows at the lower right.
must_show: one thick round disc with a raised rim
two crossed swords on the face

what: a seal of the Abyss: one thick round disc of dry, cracked, withered metal the colour of dead straw, a seal as wide as a man's palm and as thick as a finger, like a huge heavy coin, with a broad raised rim all the way round. Filling its face, inlaid in black, is the solid black silhouette of one single drooping ear of wheat on a bent stalk. The surface is dry and split by fine black cracks like parched earth. It has no chain, no loop and no handle.
colours: Dull pale straw-yellow and dry dust-brown, a matt black wheat-ear mark, fine black cracks.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, a round disc tilted a very little so that its thick edge shows at the lower right.
must_show: one thick round disc with a raised rim
one black ear of wheat on the face

what: a seal of the Abyss: one thick round disc of corroded bronze gone a sickly green, a seal as wide as a man's palm and as thick as a finger, like a huge heavy coin, with a broad raised rim all the way round. Filling its face, raised in the metal, is one plain crown with three points. The disc is blotched and pocked with dark pits and pale blisters all over. It has no chain, no loop and no handle.
colours: Sickly dull yellow-green, like an old copper roof gone bad, with dark green-black pits, pale grey-green blotches and a darker green crown.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, a round disc tilted a very little so that its thick edge shows at the lower right.
must_show: one thick round disc with a raised rim
one three-pointed crown on the face

what: a seal of the Abyss: one thick round disc of pale bone-white metal, matt and chalky like an old headstone, a seal as wide as a man's palm and as thick as a finger, like a huge heavy coin, with a broad raised rim all the way round. Filling its face, cut deep so that it shows dark, is the simple outline of a horse's head in profile, facing left, like a chess knight. A faint grey frost dulls the rim. It has no chain, no loop and no handle.
colours: Pale chalk bone-white, pale grey shading, the horse's head mark dark charcoal grey.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, a round disc tilted a very little so that its thick edge shows at the lower right.
must_show: one thick round disc with a raised rim
dark horse-head mark on the face

what: a seal of the Abyss: one thick round disc of rough grey stone-like iron, a seal as wide as a man's palm and as thick as a finger, like a huge heavy coin, with a broad raised rim all the way round. One wide jagged black crack splits its face from the top edge to the bottom edge like a bolt of lightning, as wide as a finger, with two smaller cracks branching from it, and the two halves have slipped a little so the rim no longer lines up. The face is otherwise blank. It has no chain, no loop and no handle.
colours: Rough mid-grey with dark slate-grey shadows and pale grey chipped edges, a pitch-black crack.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, a round disc tilted a very little so that its thick edge shows at the lower right.
must_show: one thick round disc with a raised rim
one wide jagged black crack splitting it from top to bottom

what: a seal of the Abyss: one thick round disc of pale polished silver, smooth as a mirror, a seal as wide as a man's palm and as thick as a finger, like a huge heavy coin, with a broad raised rim all the way round. Its face is perfectly smooth and blank, with nothing on it but the soft reflection of light, and seven small round silver studs are spaced evenly round the raised rim. It has no chain, no loop and no handle.
colours: Bright pale silver-white with soft pale grey shading and one broad white glint across the face.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, a round disc tilted a very little so that its thick edge shows at the lower right.
must_show: one thick round disc with a raised rim

what: a closed plain wooden chest: one sturdy, honest travelling chest of dark oak planks, wider than it is tall, with a low gently curved lid. Two plain dark iron straps run over the lid and down the front, and between them on the front is a small square iron lock plate with a keyhole. The wood is scuffed and darkened with age; there is no ornament anywhere.
colours: Dark walnut-brown oak planks with visible grain and paler worn edges, dark grey iron straps and lock plate, a black keyhole.

what: a closed wooden chest with a trap built into it: one sturdy chest of dark mahogany-brown planks, wider than it is tall, with a flat lid. Where the lid meets the box, all along the front, the iron edging is cut into a row of big triangular iron teeth, the teeth of the lid pointing down and meshing with the teeth of the box pointing up, like the closed jaws of a bear trap. Below the teeth, in the middle of the front, is a round iron lock plate with a keyhole, and on each side of it one small round black hole.
colours: Dark mahogany-brown wood with paler worn edges, dark grey iron teeth and fittings with pale steel tips, black holes.
must_show: dark wooden chest, flat lid, closed
row of iron teeth along the join of the lid

what: a closed iron chest: one heavy chest made entirely of dark iron plates, wider than it is tall, with a high rounded barrel lid. Three broad iron hoops run over the lid and down the body, each with a row of big round rivet heads, a thick iron ring handle hangs at each end, and a round iron lock plate with a keyhole sits in the middle of the front. No wood anywhere.
colours: Dark charcoal-grey iron with paler steel-grey worn edges and rivet heads, brown-black in the grooves, a black keyhole.
must_show: all-iron chest with a rounded barrel lid

what: a closed spiked chest: one stout chest of dark oak planks, wider than it is tall, with a low curved lid, bound by three broad dark iron bands that run over the lid and down the front. Out of every band stand big cone-shaped iron spikes, each as long as a hand and as thick as a thumb at its root: a row of four along each band on the lid, pointing up and outward, and two more on each front corner. A square iron lock plate sits in the middle of the front.
colours: Dark walnut-brown oak, dark grey iron bands, pale steel-grey spikes with bright tips, a black keyhole.
must_show: dark wooden chest with iron bands
big cone spikes standing up from the lid

what: a small steel vault: one upright strongbox of thick bright steel plate, a block a little taller than it is wide, with sharp square corners and a flat top. Its whole front is one heavy steel door, set in a thick frame, with two massive hinges down its left side and three thick round bolt-ends showing down its right side. In the middle of the door is one big handle made of four straight steel bars joined at the centre like a plus sign, with a round knob at the end of each bar, and below it a keyhole. It is shut.
colours: Bright pale steel with a cool blue-grey sheen, the blue of a winter sky in its highlights, dark slate-grey in the seams, a black keyhole.
must_show: one big door on the front with hinges
four-armed handle in the middle of the door

what: an electrified vault: one upright strongbox of dark gunmetal steel plate, a block a little taller than it is wide, with a flat top and one heavy door on its front that has a keyhole in a round plate. Thick bare copper wire is wound round the whole box in five level turns like a coil. From the flat top rise two short thick copper posts, one at each end, each ending in a round copper ball, and between the two balls jumps one thick, bright yellow, zigzag spark that touches both.
colours: Dark gunmetal-grey steel, old dull brown copper like a worn coin for the wire, posts and balls, one bright yellow zigzag spark with a white core.
must_show: two copper posts with balls on top
bright yellow spark between the balls

what: a closed enchanted coffer: one small fine coffer, wider than it is tall, with a low arched lid, lacquered a deep midnight blue. Its edges are bound in bright silver, and big silver stars with five points are inlaid across its lid and front, about seven in all, each as wide as a hand. Its clasp, in the middle of the front, is a silver crescent moon. On the very top of the lid sits one clear crystal shaped like a short thick six-sided prism with a pointed tip, glowing pale sky-blue with a white heart.
colours: Deep midnight blue lacquer, bright silver-white edges, stars and moon, one pale sky-blue glowing crystal with a white core.
must_show: dark blue coffer with silver edges
one glowing pale blue crystal on the lid

what: a closed cursed coffer: one small coffer of charcoal-black wood, wider than it is tall, with a flat lid, warped and split with age. Two heavy chains of big tarnished grey iron links are wrapped right round it, one from side to side and one from front to back over the lid, lying tight against the wood, and where they cross in the middle of the front they are held by one big old iron padlock. All along the crack between lid and box a line of sickly pale green light leaks out, and one thin curl of the same green vapour rises from the front left corner of the lid, joined to it.
colours: Charcoal-black wood, tarnished mid-grey iron chains and padlock, a sickly pale yellow-green glow at the seam.
must_show: one big iron padlock on the front
sickly green glow at the lid seam

what: a dragon's hoard chest standing open: one very large chest whose box and thrown-back lid are covered in big overlapping dragon scales, each scale as large as a hand, dark red with a black edge, bound at the corners with thick gold. The lid stands open, upright behind the box, and the box is heaped far above its rim with a rounded mound of gold coins. On the very top of the mound rests one gold crown, and one large green gem and one large white pearl sit among the coins. At each front corner the gold corner-piece ends below in a curved dragon claw of gold, which the chest stands on.
colours: Dark red scales edged in black, bright yellow gold coins, bands, claws and crown, one deep emerald-green gem, one white pearl.
must_show: open chest heaped high with gold coins
covered in dark red dragon scales
gold crown on top of the heap
must_not_show: coins spilled on the floor around it

what: a closed inferno chest: one heavy chest of scorched black iron, wider than it is tall, with a low curved lid, its plates buckled and cracked by heat. Through the cracks in its plates, and all along the join of the lid, shows the bright glow of a furnace inside, as if the chest were full of live coals: a network of glowing cracks like cooling lava. A row of small low flames, no taller than a hand, licks up from the lid seam along the front, joined to the chest. The lock plate is a blackened iron disc with a keyhole that glows.
colours: Soot-black iron, cracks glowing deep orange with yellow-white hearts, small orange and yellow flames, a glowing orange keyhole.
must_show: glowing orange cracks all over it
small flames along the lid seam

what: one old heavy key, drawn very thick and bold, short and stout. Its bow, the handle, is the main thing and fills half the key: one big thick round ring of dark iron, a fat hoop like a doughnut, with a large round garnet set in the middle of the hoop and filling it, a smooth domed stone that glows deep red like an ember. Out of the bow sticks one short thick stub of round shaft, as thick as a thumb and no longer than the bow is wide, and at the end of the stub is the bit: two big square teeth of iron standing side by side with a gap between them.
colours: Dark iron with broad pale steel-grey highlights on every edge so it reads clearly; one deep glowing red stone in the bow.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the round bow with its red stone at the bottom left corner, the two square teeth at the top right corner.
must_show: big round bow with a red stone in it
two big square teeth at the top right
pale lit edges on dark iron

what: an old tarnished chalice, a plain church cup that has stood forgotten for years: a wide deep bowl shaped like half an egg, a short thick stem with one round knob in its middle, and a broad round flat foot as wide as the bowl. It is silver gone dark with tarnish: dull grey-black in the hollows and over most of it, rubbed back to pale silver only on the rim, the knob and the edge of the foot. It is empty, plain, with no jewels and no engraving.
colours: Tarnished silver: dark smoky grey over most of it, pale silver-white on the rubbed rim, knob and foot, a faint cool sheen.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above, so the dark oval of the empty mouth just shows.
must_show: one chalice: bowl, stem with a knob, round foot
dark tarnished silver with pale rubbed edges

what: the golden fleece: one sheepskin, a thick woolly pelt with the wool still on it, folded once in half over an unseen rail so that it hangs down in a broad flat shape like a saddle blanket, wider at the bottom than at the top, its bottom edge ragged, with two short stubby flaps at the two bottom corners. It is only a skin: a flat hanging sheet of wool. The whole of it is covered in deep thick wool made of big tight round curls, each curl as big as a walnut, and every curl is bright metallic gold.
colours: Bright yellow gold like a new gold coin, pale yellow-white highlights on every curl, deep brown-gold only in the gaps between the curls.
pose: Hanging flat, seen from the front, the fold at the top, the ragged edge and two corner flaps at the bottom.
must_show: one hanging woolly pelt, wider at the bottom
big round curls of wool all over

what: an unfinished hammer-head straight from a dwarf's forge, with no handle: one heavy block of dark iron, a plain rectangular brick twice as long as it is tall, with two flat square striking faces at its ends and one round empty hole straight down through its middle from the top face, the socket where a handle will one day go. The hole is empty and dark. The block is still rough: its faces are dented with hammer marks and flaked with black forge scale, its corners not yet squared. Its right-hand end still glows from the fire.
colours: Dark charcoal-grey iron with pale steel-grey lit edges; the right-hand third glowing deep orange with a yellow heart, cooling to dull dark iron on the left.
pose: Lying level by itself, its long side to the viewer, seen from the front and a little from above so the round socket hole in its top face shows as a dark oval.
must_show: one rough iron block, a hammer head
no handle: an empty round socket hole in the top

what: one ingot of lead, the base metal an alchemist starts from: a single solid heavy bar of metal shaped exactly like a gold bar from a treasury, but made of dull grey lead. It is a long solid block twice as long as it is wide, whose four sides slope inward so that its flat top is a little smaller than its flat bottom. The top is flat, solid and closed, with one long shallow scratch across it. The metal is dull, soft and matt, never shiny: its corners and edges are blunted, and one corner is dented in.
colours: Dull dark neutral grey like pencil lead, the same grey a lead roof has, pale grey only along the worn edges and on the top face, charcoal on the shaded side; no shine and no colour in it.
pose: Lying by itself on a slant, one end at the bottom left and the other at the top right, seen from a little above so its top face, one long side and one end show.
must_show: one solid loaf-shaped bar of metal with sloping sides

what: a king's seal, a seal-stamp for pressing into wax: one thick round disc of bright gold as wide as a palm and as thick as a finger, like a very big heavy coin with a raised plain rim, its flat face turned to the viewer. Filling the face is one bold hexagram inlaid in solid black: one triangle pointing up laid over one triangle pointing down, so that it has six points in all, one straight up, one straight down and two on each side, each line of it as thick as a finger. At the top of the disc is one small gold lug with a hole through it. It is a seal, not a ring: there is no hoop.
colours: Bright yellow gold disc with brown-gold shadows and pale gold highlights on the rim; the six-pointed star solid black.
pose: Upright, seen from the front, its round face flat towards the viewer, the lug at the top.
must_show: bold black six-pointed star of two triangles on its face
must_not_show: coin with a head on it

what: one sprig of a healing herb, freshly picked, a single plant and not a bunch: one stout upright green stem with six broad smooth oval leaves growing from it in three pairs, each leaf as big as a thumb with one pale vein down its middle, and at the very top of the stem one single open flower with five broad rounded petals of bright golden yellow. The cut bottom of the stem is bound with a short strip of clean white linen bandage, wound round three times.
colours: Fresh bright emerald-green stem and leaves with pale veins; one bright golden-yellow flower; a white linen wrap at the foot.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the linen-bound stem end at the bottom left, the yellow flower at the top right.
must_show: one single sprig with broad oval leaves in pairs
one yellow five-petalled flower at the top
white linen wrap at the stem end

what: the boulder: one enormous round boulder of rough weathered rock, nearly a ball, a little lopsided, lumpy and pitted, with a few shallow cracks. Pressed flat on the middle of its front is one pale worn print of an open human hand, five fingers spread, as wide as a third of the boulder, the stone there rubbed smooth and pale by endless pushing. It is only a rock: it has no features.
colours: Dark weathered brown-grey stone, darker in the pits and cracks, pale grey on the lit upper left; one pale chalk-white hand print.
pose: Resting by itself, seen from the front, the hand print facing the viewer.
must_show: one pale hand print on its front

what: a thief's lockpicks, three picks on one ring, drawn very thick and bold. At the bottom left is one thick round ring of dark iron, a fat hoop. Threaded on the ring and spreading out from it towards the top right, like three spread fingers, are three flat picks of pale steel, each a broad flat strip as wide as a finger and three times as long as the ring is wide, with clear dark gaps between them. Each strip ends in a different small tip: the upper one a little upturned hook, the middle one a small round ball, the lower one a short slanted blade. Nothing else.
colours: Pale straw-tinged steel picks with dark grey shadows and bright white glints; a dark iron ring.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the ring at the bottom left corner, the three tips fanned out at the top right.
must_show: one ring with three flat steel picks fanned out from it

what: a master thief's lockpicks, three picks on one ring, all of bright gold, drawn very thick and bold. At the bottom left is one thick round ring of gold, a fat hoop. Threaded on the ring and spreading out from it towards the top right, like three spread fingers, are three flat picks of gold, each a broad flat strip as wide as a finger and three times as long as the ring is wide, with clear dark gaps between them. Each strip ends in a different small tip: the upper one a little upturned hook, the middle one a wavy tip with three rounded humps, the lower one a short slanted blade. Nothing else.
colours: Bright yellow gold all over with brown-gold shadows and pale gold glints.
pose: Lying on a diagonal, the ring at the bottom left corner, the three tips fanned out at the top right.
must_show: one gold ring with three flat gold picks fanned out from it

what: a small heap of gold coins: about fifteen thick round gold coins, each a fifth as wide as the heap, piled loosely into one low rounded mound, wider than it is tall, the coins overlapping and touching so that the heap is one solid piece, some lying flat and some tilted on edge. The coins are old and plain, each with a simple raised rim.
colours: Rich yellow gold with deep brown-gold shadows between the coins and bright pale gold glints on their rims.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, one low mound.
must_show: one low heap of gold coins

what: a deep gnome trader, a travelling pedlar of the underground: a short, stout, kindly old gnome, half the height of a man and nearly as wide as he is tall, with a big round nose, a broad friendly smile, bushy white eyebrows, a short white beard and large pointed ears. On his back he carries an enormous bulging pedlar's pack of dark canvas, taller than he is and rising high above his head, strapped with leather belts and hung with a tin pot, a coil of rope and a rolled blanket. He is sturdy and real, with a head of ordinary size for a stout dwarf-like body.
colours: Pale stone-grey skin with a faint blue-grey tint, white beard and eyebrows, a dark forest-green hooded cloak, a walnut-brown tunic, a dark brown canvas pack with tan leather straps, a dull brass lantern with a warm yellow light.
wears: He wears a dark green travelling cloak with its hood thrown back off his bare bald head, a brown belted tunic to the knees, and stout dark leather boots.
holds: In his left hand he holds up exactly one small brass lantern with a warm yellow light in it, by its ring. His right hand is empty, raised open beside his shoulder in a friendly wave.
pose: He trudges forward on two short legs in mid-stride, leaning forward under the weight of the huge pack, face turned to the viewer with a smile, right hand raised in greeting, lantern held out low in front of him in his left.
must_show: short stout grey-skinned gnome with a white beard
huge pack on his back rising above his head
one lantern in his left hand
open empty right hand raised in greeting
